svg.title: Comparing alternatives
svg.desc: What is placed in a common comparison frame? The comparand distinguishes candidate selection, variation of the same object, and comparison against groups or reference points. Source illustration: The interface aligns multiple image descriptions in a detailed narrative and a separate discrepancy summary.

text.tspan: What is placed in a common comparison frame?
Places alternatives, cases or states in a common frame so people
can examine their similarities, differences and trade-offs.
Recorded form · FC024: Side-by-side comparison of alternatives (VA023).
